title: Seeing Time: Visual-Temporal Representation Learning for Interpretable Time Series Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2609.36873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate Time Series (MTS) clustering is an important tool in temporal data mining, aiming to discover latent group structures from complex observations without supervision. Although existing deep clustering methods can learn discriminative temporal representations, the resulting latent clusters are often difficult to relate back to waveform characteristics that practitioners can directly inspect and compare, limiting their ability to assess whether the discovered patterns reflect meaningful temporal behaviors. This paper, therefore, proposes WAVE (Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding), which treats time series and their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views of the same observations. translated_title: 看见时间：面向可解释时间序列聚类的视觉-时序表示学习
translated_abstract: 多元时间序列（MTS）聚类是时序数据挖掘中的一项重要工具，旨在无监督条件下从复杂观测中发现潜在的群组结构。尽管现有的深度聚类方法能够学习具有判别性的时序表示，但其得到的潜在聚类往往难以与从业者可直接查看和比较的波形特征关联起来，这限制了它们评估所发现模式是否反映有意义时序行为的能力。因此，本文提出了WAVE（Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding，波形对齐的视觉-时序嵌入），该方法将时间序列及其确定性渲染的波形图视为同一观测对象的互补视图。为了生成聚类结构可追溯到可观察波形特征的判别性表示，WAVE将细粒度的时序变化与整体视觉模式进行对齐与融合……
tldr: 该论文提出WAVE方法，将时间序列与其渲染出的波形图作为互补视图进行对齐融合，使聚类结构能够追溯到可观察的波形特征，从而实现可解释的多元时间序列聚类。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes WAVE, which aligns time series with their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views, producing discriminative representations whose cluster structures can be traced to observable waveform characteristics for interpretable multivariate time series clustering.
